title: Sustainable Improvement of 7075 Aluminum Alloy with Modified Graphene Oxide
content: The demand for lightweight materials with enhanced mechanical properties is increasing, particularly in aerospace and automotive industries. Aluminum alloy 7075 (Al-7075) is favored for its high strength-to-weight ratio, but further improvements are needed [1-3]. Graphene-based reinforcements offer a promising solution by enhancing mechanical performance while maintaining low density. This study focuses on synthesizing reduced graphene oxide (RGO) and incorporating it into Al-7075 via an environmentally friendly method.
